source_text: Οὗτος οὖν μόνος καὶ κατὰ πάντων θεὸς λόγον πρῶτον ἐννοηθεὶς ἀπογεννᾷ, οὐ λόγον ὡς φωνήν, ἀλλ᾿ ἐνδιάθετον τοῦ παντὸς λογισμόν. Τοῦτον μόνον ἐξ ὄντων ἐγέννα· τὸ γὰρ ὂν αὐτὸς ὁ πατὴρ ἦν, ἐξ οὗ τὸ γεννηθέν. Αἴτιον τοῖς γινομένοις λόγος ἦν, ἐν ἑαυτῷ φέρων τὸ θέλειν τοῦ γεγεννηκότος, οὐκ ἄπειρος τῆς τοῦ πατρὸς ἐννοίας· ἅμα γὰρ τῷ ἐκ τοῦ γεννήσαντος προελθεῖν, πρωτότοκος τούτου γενόμενος φωνή, ἔχει ἐν ἑαυτῷ τὰς ἐν τῷ πατρὶ προεννοηθείσας ἰδέας, ὅθεν κελεύοντος πατρὸς γίνεσθαι κόσμον τὸ κατὰ ἓν λόγος ἀπετελεῖτο ἀρέσκων θεῷ.
pass_a_gloss: This one therefore alone and according to all God first having been conceived in mind brings forth Logos, not Logos as sound, but inward thought of all reasoning. This one alone I generated from existing things; for the existing thing itself was the Father, from whom the generated thing. Logos was cause for the things being generated, carrying in itself the will of the generated one, not without the Father's conception; for at the same time as proceeding from the one generating, having become firstborn of this one, sound, it has in itself the ideas preconceived in the Father, whence, the Father commanding to generate the world, the Logos according to one was being brought to completion, pleasing to God.

pass_b_english: This One therefore alone and according to all God, having first been conceived in mind, brings forth Logos — not Logos as sound, but as the inward thought of all reasoning. He alone was generated from existing things; for the existing thing itself was the Father, from whom the generated thing came. Logos was cause for the things being generated, carrying in itself the will of the One who generated Him, not without the Father's conception; for at the same time as He proceeded from the One generating, having become firstborn of this One as Sound, He has in Himself the ideas preconceived in the Father, whence, the Father commanding the world to be generated, the Logos according to One was being brought to completion, pleasing to God.
